summary.en: Work and break timer with a separate Windows on Arm installer.
summary.zh-TW: 工作與休息計時器，提供專用的 Windows on Arm 安裝程式。

caveats.en: The release notes say the arm64 installer is only for Windows on ARM devices; the asset list was not visible on the page and no RTX Spark test is stated.
caveats.zh-TW: 發行說明寫明 arm64 安裝程式僅適用 Windows on ARM 裝置；頁面未顯示檔案清單，也沒有 RTX Spark 的測試說明。
